Subject: Banking proof + remittance field examples for Redwood PO routing

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Attached are the documents finance asked for so we can be set up to receive PO payments: a company bank letter (bank confirms routing/account ending), our W-9, and a small CSV with our preferred remittance fields (invoice reference / PO / remit note).

Quick details you may need to validate on your side:
- Bank: First Horizon Commercial Banking
- Account: Ending 4321
- ACH routing: 061000104
- Suggested remit string: NORTHSTAR_INV|PO:{PO_NUMBER}|INV:{INVOICE_NO}

We can accept either ACH or wire. If you need a micro-deposit check, we can confirm once we see the test amounts.

Attachments: NorthStar_W9.pdf, BankLetter_NorthStar_20280322.pdf, RemitFormatExample.csv

Let me know if you need anything else before your AP team completes the vendor profile.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendez
Head of Finance Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Banking proof + remittance field examples for Redwood PO routing

Hi Carlos —

Appreciate the docs and the remit template. A couple quick items from our side so AP can finish onboarding: 

1) Can you confirm the legal entity on the W-9 matches the one on your bank letter exactly (including punctuation)? Our system requires exact match for ACH enrollment.
2) For PO mapping: please confirm whether you want the PO encoded as PO:RN-#### (you used {PO_NUMBER} in the CSV). We generally push PO into a single Invoice.Reference field. If you prefer a distinct PO token in the remit string, we can map it to PO field in our payment file.
3) Would you like us to do ACH micro-deposits (two test deposits) or run an immediate wire for the first payment? Micro-deposits are the default for new vendors unless you request a wire.

Next steps I’ll take after you confirm: Priyom (cc'd) will create the vendor profile, assign the SN/GL mapping, and Jordan will ensure the PO routing rule includes your remit token so invoices reconcile automatically. 

If you’re good with micro-deposits, we typically send two test deposits under $0.50 within 48–72 hours; please confirm which account they will land in (checking vs. savings).

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@northstar-supply.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northstar-supply.com>, accounts-payable@northstar-supply.com
Date: Sat, 24 Mar 2028 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Banking proof + remittance field examples for Redwood PO routing

Thanks Hannah — quick answers inline: 

> Can you confirm the legal entity on the W-9 matches the bank letter?
Yes, the W-9 lists: NorthStar Supply Company, Inc. and our bank letter is issued to the same exact legal name (no punctuation differences).

> PO mapping format
We prefer PO encoded as PO:NS-<number> (e.g., PO:NS-4521). If possible map that token into your Invoice.Reference so our remittance process picks it up. The CSV we sent shows the column "remit_note" which contains PO and invoice keys.

> Micro-deposits or wire
Micro-deposits are fine. The account is a checking account. We will watch for two small deposits and reply to confirm receipt.

Attached is a signed vendor onboarding form per your questionnaire and a quick bank statement page that shows the last four digits as verification.

Attachments: NorthStar_OnboardingForm_signed.pdf (pdf), NS_BankStatementPage_4321.pdf (pdf)

Let us know when you kick the micro-deposit. Appreciate the smooth process.

Best,
Leah Turner
AP Manager — NorthStar Supply Co.
leah.turner@northstar-supply.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@northstar-supply.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northstar-supply.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Banking proof + remittance field examples for Redwood PO routing

Leah / Carlos —

Thanks for confirming and for the extra attachments. We’ve created the vendor profile in our system (Vendor ID: VND-88977) and queued the ACH micro-deposits.

Summary / what to expect: 
- Micro-deposits: two small amounts (e.g., $0.12 and $0.37) will appear in the checking account you confirmed within 48 hours. Please reply to this thread with the exact amounts when you see them so we can mark the account as verified.
- Remit mapping: we mapped PO token NS-##### into Invoice.Reference and will accept remit strings that follow NORTHSTAR_INV|PO:NS-<number>|INV:<number>. If an invoice comes in without the PO token we will still process it manually but it may delay reconciliation.
- First invoice/payment: please include the Redwood PO number on the invoice PDF and in the remit string so the payment can auto-apply.

Links we used to validate docs are in the vendor profile: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/HS-4512

If you’d rather receive a wire for the first payment after verification instead, reply and we’ll change the payment method. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the micro-deposits.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
